entry.title: Afterword to Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, edition 2
entry.summary: Rewritten around the route to the proof: the wrong turns where they happened, the paper's proofs pointed to instead of retold, and why the log log X is forced.

entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v3
entry.summary: Says what the paper introduced, notes in the text that Barreto's post is no longer available, corrects the explanation of why only inert primes count, adds a remark showing why the log log X is forced on this construction, shortens the abstract, and adds van Dijk's class-number-one sieve to the comparison.

entry.title: Afterword to Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, edition 1
entry.summary: The idea behind the proof in a few minutes: Mertens’ theorem by a Vandermonde determinant, the same argument in a quadratic field, and why the nonvanishing works modulo a prime.

entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v2
entry.summary: Following Barreto, a rectangular box of points lowers the coefficient of log q from ½ to ¼ and gives (1−β) log q ≥ 1 − O(log log q / log q). The nonvanishing argument is unchanged, the exposition is rewritten, and the comparison with other proofs adds Barreto's and van Dijk's. The introduction now requires p to be odd where v1 did not. Merges the revisions posted earlier the same day.

entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v1
entry.summary: A proof that real Dirichlet L-functions have no Landau–Siegel zero, via a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma at an auxiliary inert prime. The mathematics and the text were produced by AI systems.
